storage: builder_draft_experiences.editor_meta (json, nullable); saved by PUT draft under the same optimistic lock and revision
rules: the schema stays the single source: editor_meta never carries structure
node entries are scoped by page ('nodes.<pageId>.<nodeId>'): component.id is unique only within a page, so hiding a node on one page never affects a same-id node on another page
hidden nodes (and their children) are removed from published versions, preview sessions and contract issues (EditorMeta::project); they stay in the draft
names, presets and page titles never leave the draft
page/node ids that no longer exist in the saved schema (or sit under the wrong page) are pruned silently; a page root cannot be hidden (422 editor_meta_hidden_root)
unknown keys, wrong types, over-long text, non-object entries, or more than max_editor_meta_bytes (default 65536) => 422 with no write
